notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for consecutive ordinary receive-order interactions. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies adapter-supplied interaction and parameter lookups, publication, active subscription, two ordinary Send Interaction callbacks in producer order, delivery metadata, sender exclusion, and standard federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction-class lookup, publication, active subscription, ordinary Send Interaction, unsubscription, unpublication, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador ordinary interaction and FederateAmbassador delivery declarations
